item.title: Councillors give initial approval to move ahead with municipal accommodation tax in Norfolk
item.description: Norfolk County council has taken its first step towards creating a municipal accommodation tax (MAT) for overnight stays in the county. At a council-in-committee meeting on Tuesday, implementation of this MAT was approved in principle, along with approval of a draft short-term rental bylaw. Final approval is required at a council meeting on March 24. […]

item.title: King relishes “breakthrough experience” at the Brier
item.description: The past two weeks gave a chance for Canadian curling fans to discover what folks in Norfolk and Tillsonburg have known for years: Jayden King is a rising star.

item.title: Decision delayed on potential move of Simcoe's Lynnwood Arts centre
item.description: A decision about the future location of Lynnwood Arts and its $3.1-million art collection has been delayed. At a council-in-committee meeting on March 10, Norfolk councillors agreed to give county staff a month to do some further investigation into safe storage for the collection and consult with other local heritage groups. item.title: Norfolk councillor wants to speed up road repair after harsh winter
item.description: The harsh winter has taken a toll on Norfolk County roads. Coun. Chris VanPaassen wants to get them back in shape for spring. “I’ve noticed that winter was not kind to Norfolk County’s roads and infrastructure,” he said a council-in-committee meeting on Tuesday. “The trees are down. item.title: Norfolk's oldest building, constructed in 1849, to be protected when county sells Teeterville property
item.description: A couple of properties, including Norfolk County’s oldest building, will remain protected when the municipality sells a parcel of land in Teeterville.
